text:
maria: Quick ping — can we tweak the weekly triage cadence for next sprint? Thinking 30m, sharper agenda, rotate bug-queue owner weekly. Current slot (Thurs 16:00) collides with a few PM reviews.
kevin: I can't do Thurs 16:00 next week. +1 for 30m. available Fri 10:00 or Thurs 09:30.
sunil: Fri 10 works better for infra folks. If we move, can we lock the agenda to: 1) blockers (5m) 2) bug queue triage (15m) 3) RFC/dev-design quick hits (8m) 4) action items (2m). Keep it tight. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jen: I can take bug-queue owner next week if we keep the shorter slot. Will surface the >P2s beforehand.
alex: +1 on rotating owner. Can we add a quick "regressions" filter in the triage board and pin it to the meeting? Makes the 15m triage faster.
priya: Agree on the board filter. I'll create `triage/meeting` saved view with `label:regression OR priority:P1 OR age:>7d`. Sharing link in a sec.
maria: Perfect. If we move to Fri 10:00, I'll update calendar and set the agenda template. One more ask — add an RFC review slot for <5min quick sanity checks (not full reviews). Use `RFC` tag in thread title.
kevin: For RFCs, maybe use a rolling 5-min slot to call out blockers only. If something needs more time, schedule a separate deep-dive.
triage-bot: Reminder: weekly-triage board snapshot saved at 2026-01-15T09:00Z. 23 new issues in backlog, 4 regressions, 7 age>7d.
sunil: Can we also enforce a 2-issue cap per owner to avoid long dives? owners should add quick notes like "action: revert? assign?" so the meeting stays focused.
jen: I'll post the owners rota for the next 6 weeks after this thread. Who wants week 3? @alex?
alex: I can take week 3. Also volunteer to do the first RFC sanity pass next meeting.
maria: OK — plan: move to Fri 10:00 next week, set meeting to 30m, agenda as Sunil suggested, rotating bug-owner (Jen week1, Priya week2, Alex week3), add `triage/meeting` saved view and RFC quick-check slot. I'll update calendar + send out a short pre-read checklist (labels, short notes, links).
kevin: Sounds good. If anyone can't make Fri 10, drop a reaction and we can do a quick follow-up. :thumbsup:
priya: Link to saved view: https://redwood.slack/triage/meeting-view (mock link). I also added `triage-template` checklist to the board.
maria: Thanks all — I'll push calendar change in 15m and add the agenda template to the event. If anything urgent before then, DM me.
